text:
Ravi: incident-bot paged me for a sudden jump in streaming disconnects + tool-call parse errors in prod-us-east-1. Reports show some tool-calls cause the SSE stream to close immediately.

incident-bot: ALERT  2176543210  SSE disconnect rate increased 14x in prod-us-east-1 between 09:22-09:26 UTC. 91% of failed streams contain tool-call payloads.

Elena: I'm taking lead. Morgan, grab proxy + ingest logs and any deploys in the last 2 hours. Zoe, loop in SDK owners if we can ID client-side changes.

Morgan: pulling traces now. Support flagged one customer (acct-NEBULA) with ~50% session drops. They pasted an example payload: ``{"cmd":"call","args":[{"k":"v",},],"meta":{}}``  note trailing comma inside inner object and array.

Zoe: pinging @sdk-team. Early telemetry shows a spike of sdk-python 0.9.7 usage around the window. That release included a helper that serializes empty/optional fields weirdly.

Ravi: any runtime changes?
deploy-bot: DEPLOY  2176543005  prod-us-east-1 runtime: parser hardening PR #5120 (commit a7b9d2) deployed at 09:18 UTC. Edge tweak PR #5118 (frame-alignment) deployed at 09:20 UTC.

Morgan: logs snippet:
```
[edge] 09:22:14 conn=9f89 upgrade ok
[ingest] 09:22:16 req=kk22 parser=JSONError: Trailing comma at pos 42
[ingest] 09:22:16 req=kk22 action=terminate_stream reason=parse_failure
```

Elena: that shows parser error then stream termination. Two possible vectors: (1) client sending invalid JSON (trailing commas), (2) edge frame change exposing partial serialization that creates trailing commas during chunking.

Zoe: SDK telemetry: 84% of failures map to sdk-python 0.9.7; small number from sdk-go 1.3.4. Looks like a client regression is primary.

Ravi: mitigation options: A) revert parser hardening (blast radius), B) hotfix sanitizer that normalizes common trailing-comma patterns at ingest, C) require clients to upgrade + send out CS notice. Recommend B as fastest.

incident-bot: RECOMMENDATION  create sanitizer + roll to canary (5%), contact SDK team to produce patch, add metric malformed_toolcall_total by sdk_version.

Morgan: implementing sanitizer as a pre-parse filter. Plan: naive trailing-comma stripper that runs on the tool-call body, logs redacted original to secure storage, increments telemetry. Canary to 5% first. Pushing in ~3m.

Elena: ensure sanitizer returns structured client error on second failure rather than closing stream. Also add sampling for full payloads for security review.

Zoe: contacting SDK team. They're triaging a serialization bug in 0.9.7 and will prepare 0.9.8. Asked for ETA: ~90m for patch & release.

Ravi: handover: I'll stay primary until we confirm sanitizer effectiveness. Elena, you'll be secondary and own RCA documentation. Morgan, own sanitizer rollout and telemetry. Zoe, own SDK coordination and CS comms.

Morgan: canary deployed at 09:25 UTC to 5% traffic. Monitoring for disconnect rate, latency, and error logs.

incident-bot: METRIC UPDATE  sanitizer canary: disconnects down 86% in cohort within 45s; no CPU increase observed.

Elena: expand to 25% and watch for any parsing edge-cases sanitizer might introduce. Morgan, make sure sanitizer is conservative: only strip trailing commas in object/array contexts.

Morgan: scaling to 25% at 09:27. Capturing raw payload samples (redacted) into s3://secure-logs/rca/2176543210/ for later analysis.

Zoe: CS notified NEBULA and offered two options: temporary rollback to older SDK or accept server mitigation + patch ETA. They accepted mitigation path and requested postmortem.

Ravi: timeline so far: 09:18 runtime parser hardening deploy, 09:20 edge frame-alignment deploy, 09:22 alerts begin, 09:25 sanitizer canary, 09:28 sanitizer expanded. Need full timeline and evidence matrix for RCA.

Elena: preliminary hypotheses to track: H1: client regression (sdk-python 0.9.7 emits trailing commas) + server strict parser = failures. H2: edge frame change increases fragmentation that triggers malformed toolcall bodies. H3: unrelated malformed payload injection (low). We'll collect logs to support/deny.

Morgan: early evidence: reproducer runs with malformed payload fail on strict parser locally. Edge traces show normal upgrade handshake; no proxy errors prior to parser failures. This favors H1.

incident-bot: ACTIONS CREATED  1) Sanitize at ingest (owner: Morgan), 2) SDK patch (owner: sdk-team/Zoe), 3) Telemetry metric malformed_toolcall_total (owner: infra), 4) Add compatibility gate for future parser rollouts (owner: runtime/Ravi).

Ravi: good. Also add automated compatibility tests against a matrix of SDK versions before flipping parser behavior in production. Morgan, add telemetry label sdk_version to malformed counter.

Morgan: sanitizer at 100% at 09:31 UTC. Region error-rate returned to baseline by 09:34. No perf regression.

incident-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE  sanitizer rolled to 100% at 09:31:42 UTC. Region SSE disconnects recovered.

Zoe: SDK team: patch ready, publishing 0.9.8 now; release notes explain the bug and include migration tests. ETA ~1h for packages to propagate.

Elena: starting RCA doc: will include timeline, evidence matrix, reproducer snippets, sanitized payload samples, and a list of action items with owners & deadlines. Draft link: https://internal.docs/rca/2176543210/draft

Ravi: follow-ups: - add feature flag for strict parser and gate by compatibility tests, - CI fuzzing for tool-call JSON permutations, - instrument alert on malformed_toolcall_total > threshold, - SDK release + customer outreach. Assign owners and due dates in RCA doc.

Morgan: uploading logs + sample payloads to secure bucket; linking in RCA doc.

Zoe: CS updated NEBULA and other impacted accounts; they'll want final postmortem and timeline. I've scheduled a follow-up call with NEBULA engineering lead.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STABLE  root cause: sdk-python 0.9.7 emitted trailing commas in some tool-call serializers; runtime parser hardening in PR #5120 caused strict rejection. Mitigation: ingest sanitizer deployed; SDK patch in progress.

Elena: handing to Ravi to own post-incident review. I'll finalize RCA and set deadlines. Thanks team for quick action. :thumbsup:

Morgan: will open PRs for sanitizer (#5128) and telemetry (#5129) and attach to RCA.

Ravi: closing thread once RCA published. Good work.
